recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-28605; future changes to current gender-identity terminology should be made through THO or the relevant external terminology source.
issue_request: FHIR-28605 was a Published/Persuasive PA R5 technical correction asking that the gender-identity value set's non-disclose wording say "their gender identity" instead of "his gender identity".
initial_application: Git commit 5717fbdcb8ef57518606578a52d5e83ac6d1031e applied the issue by changing source/patient/codesystem-gender-identity.xml for the non-disclose concept from "the individual does not wish to disclose his gender identity" to "the individual does not wish to disclose their gender identity".
additional_context: PA minutes on 2021-08-11 record the issue as persuasive with a 3-0-0 vote. Later, FHIR-38639 removed the obsolete core Gender Identity example CodeSystem after the value set moved to THO, and a subsequent cleanup removed source/patient/valueset-gender-identity.xml from core. Current core source/fhir.ini has no active gender-identity CodeSystem or ValueSet entry; source/oids.ini retains only the THO value set URL. The current THO gender-identity ValueSet no longer includes the old non-disclose code.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit is appropriate because the requested wording fix was applied before the old core CodeSystem was removed, and no current build-scope core source still contains the stale phrase.
